svg.title: Cost of error-aware retained-yield displays
svg.desc: 2026-10-22 · macOS arm64 · identical fictional inputs · before 876bf65 / after #21 One execution/configuration; uncontrolled caches/load. Exact non-display JSON values match. No additional input pass or disk scratch. Higher-fidelity bounded vertices increase serialized data; this is an accuracy/output-size trade-off, not a performance optimization.
